bullets.text: A 34-year-old woman named Nithyasree died after a private bus ran over her moped near Nazarethpet on Thursday morning, and the office should monitor local road safety.
Officials in Tiruttani are refusing to provide the 125 days of work under the national rural employment guarantee scheme to persons with disabilities, requiring office follow-up.
The Tamil Nadu government has allocated Rs 125 crore in the first phase to roll out a scheme providing AI assistive devices for persons with disabilities to ensure independent activities.

stories.title: Private bus runs over woman near Nazarethpet
takeaways: A 34-year-old woman named Nithyasree died when a private bus hit her moped near Nazarethpet on Thursday.
The fatal accident highlights urgent road safety concerns along the Vandalur-Minjur Outer Ring Road corridor.

stories.title: T.N. government to roll out scheme for AI assistive devices for persons with disability
takeaways: Tamil Nadu allocates Rs 125 crore in the first phase for AI assistive devices.
The scheme enables persons with disabilities to perform daily activities with modern technology.
